issue.title: Named and linked project tasks with ` :id` in `bob capture` and Bob Mac Capture
issue.description: A project-note capture (`@route^id+` or `@route^id+#pomodoro`) can name any of its task bullets with a trailing ` ^id`, or name them and link them into the current/next (or named) Pomodoro with a trailing ` :id`. The `^prj` task is never linked, the retired `@route:id+` forms fail with a message that teaches the new spelling, and Bob Mac Capture highlights, completes, previews, and reports the new syntax.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/project_task_links.md requests this work

issue.title: Project-note marker grammar: `@route^id+#pomodoro`, retire `@route:id+`
issue.description: marker: move the Pomodoro name onto the `^` project-note marker (`@route^id+#pomodoro`), retire the `:` project-note forms with teaching errors, stop linking or starring `^prj`, and keep execution, capture-parse, capture-complete, and help text in agreement.

issue.title: Project task IDs in the capture grammar and capture-parse
issue.description: task-id-grammar: lex trailing ` :id` / ` ^id` tokens on project-note lines, enforce the placement, validity, duplicate, checkbox, and unused-`#pomodoro` rules in both the execution and editor parsers, and expose spans, needs, modes, and `sub_bullet_task_ids` through capture-parse.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/project_task_links.md defines phase task-id-grammar as one work unit

issue.title: Render named project tasks and write their Task Links
issue.description: task-id-execution: render `^id` onto named tasks (`[*]` for `:` tasks), write one Task Link per `:` task into the selected Pomodoro atomically with the new note, and report `project_note.task_links` in JSON and human output.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/project_task_links.md defines phase task-id-execution as one work unit
